_comment: Google Workspace test users the attribute-map integration tests rely on.
This is the reference for what must exist in the test tenant. It is checked
against the suites' expectations by lib/test_google_test_data.py.
customSchemas mirrors the Directory API shape, so each user's block can be
applied as the customSchemas body of users.update/patch.
SSOSync-Test.AWSUsername is a scalar and MUST be email-shaped (ssosync also
uses the Username as the synthesized primary work email) and must differ
from the user's primary email so the remap suite updates every user.
SSOSync-Test.CostCodes is a SINGLE-VALUED custom field (a plain string): one
cost center per user. Google custom fields cannot be typed.
SSOSync-Test.ProjectCodes is a MULTI-VALUED custom field (define it with
'multiValued: true' in the schema). ssosync does not support multi-valued
custom attributes: the rich_map suite maps it and asserts it is warned about
and ignored. It is set on crpates (two values) and dave2 (one value; still
multi-valued, so still ignored) and absent on AceHole and olaf.

users.notes: Primary work organization 'Jupiter Mining Corporation' / 'Science Officer'; phones: mobile, then primary work '+44 20 7946 0001'; work address 'Deck 16, Red Dwarf'. No websites (the tenant's user schema has no websites field). The former second cost code (HOME-1) is removed.
Blank given name; only a school-typed organization; no CostCodes. SSOSync-Test.LongValue is a string over 128 characters (validation_warnings suite) and is unchanged.

Organizations: school 'Red Dwarf Academy' / 'Student' (primary), then work 'Jupiter Mining Corporation' / 'Technician, Third Class' / department 'Maintenance'; two phones, neither primary; work address 'Cargo Bay, Red Dwarf'.
